description: Purdue Qiskit Fall Fest: Clean Energy & Battery Materials Benchmarks

Li-C.name: Lithium-Graphite Anode (Industry Baseline)
Li-C.description: Standard EV battery anode. Reversible intercalation into sp2 carbon.
Li-C.application_tradeoff: High commercial maturity, moderate energy density, relies on scarce lithium.

Na-C.name: Sodium-Carbon Anode (Abundant Earth / Grid Storage)
Na-C.description: Replaces scarce Lithium with cheap, abundant Sodium for large-scale grid storage.
Na-C.application_tradeoff: 10x cheaper raw materials, lower cell voltage, ideal for stationary renewable grid storage.

Li-Si.name: Lithium-Silicon Alloy Anode (High-Capacity Next-Gen)
Li-Si.description: Silicon can bind up to 10x more lithium atoms than graphite, revolutionizing EV range.
Li-Si.application_tradeoff: Significantly higher cell voltage and energy density, higher binding affinity, material expansion challenge.

Li-N-doped.name: Nitrogen-Doped Carbon Anode (Dendrite-Free Fast Charging)
Li-N-doped.description: Doping nitrogen into the carbon host alters charge distribution, trapping lithium more tightly and preventing fires.
Li-N-doped.application_tradeoff: Maximum voltage and binding strength, suppresses dangerous dendrite formation, higher synthesis cost.
